email_draft.subject: AP Invoice Processing Escalation: Critical Issues Detected for 01_Invoice HW.png
email_draft.body:
Dear AP Manager,

During the automated processing of invoice document '01_Invoice HW.png', the following exceptions were identified:

Critical:
- SCR-001: Invoice number is missing (Field: invoice_number, Agent: screening)

Warnings:
- SCR-002: Vendor name is missing (Field: vendor_name, Agent: screening)
- SCR-003: GST number is missing (Field: gst_number, Agent: screening)
- MAT-001: Vendor name mismatch: Invoice has empty name, master has 'Shivaji Nagar Fresh Produce' (Field: vendor_name, Agent: matching)

Info:
- MAT-002: Invoice total (13470.0) is less than PO total (14770.0), but calculated invoice sum matches PO (Field: total_amount, Agent: matching)

Additional Notes:
- Screening identified missing key fields; stamp is present.
- Matching successful for PO and GRN references; minor discrepancies in extracted values.
- Discrepancy between extracted total (13470.0) and calculated sum from line items (14770.0).
- PO Number: PO1004, Vendor Code: V004, Invoice Date: 2026-04-04 (Note: Future date).
- Three-way match status: Partial Match (Qtys match; extracted total discrepant but calculated matches PO).

Please review the document and provide guidance on how to proceed. This invoice cannot be automatically approved due to the critical exception.

Best regards,
AP Automation System
